The first project is the "Profit & RTO Simulation Calculator," which is a web-based application that handles referral fees, closing fees, and 1% TCS on Amazon. He has implemented Return-to-Origin (RTO) loss scenarios and designed interactive dashboards using Chart.js to visualize revenue, cost, and profit trends. The second project is the "Multi-Platform Stock Management System," which is a full-stack inventory management system that supports multi-platform stock tracking. He has implemented real-time stock updates for sales and purchase transactions using REST APIs, developed a low-stock alert system, and enabled bulk product uploads via Excel import.
